methods.name: Random encounters
methods.plain: Any Pokémon you meet has a 1 in 8,192 chance to be shiny.
methods.detail: Shininess comes from the DVs: Defense, Speed and Special 10, Attack 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11, 14 or 15. A shiny always has those DVs.
methods.note: pokecrystal engine/gfx/color.asm CheckShininess: Defense, Speed, Special DV 10 and Attack 2/3/6/7/10/11/14/15 = 1/8,192

methods.name: Breed with a shiny parent
methods.plain: Breed a shiny Pokémon with Ditto or a partner of the other gender: about 1 in 64 eggs hatch shiny.
methods.detail: The egg copies the Defense DV and part of the Special DV from the Ditto, or else from the parent of the egg's opposite gender, so a shiny parent of the egg's own gender doesn't help. Uneven gender ratios shift the rate a little.
methods.note: pokecrystal engine/events/daycare.asm: 1/2 x 1/2 x 1/16 = 1/64; the gender-ratio effect is ignored [single]

methods.name: Odd Egg
methods.plain: The Odd Egg from the Day-Care man is shiny about 1 time in 7 (14%).
methods.detail: It hatches one of 7 babies (Pichu, Cleffa, Igglybuff, Tyrogue, Smoochum, Elekid, Magby). The shiny versions have DVs 2/10/10/10. International versions.
methods.note: pokecrystal data/events/odd_eggs.asm: the 7 shiny variants' weights add up to 14%; the Japanese mobile 50% left out (service shut down)
